cases.sentence: В тот день Девора и Варак, сын ___, спели такую песнь.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive after сын (son) indicates kinship and lineage.
The noun is the subject standing in the nominative case.
The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case when indicating origin or departure.

cases.sentence: Горы дрожали пред ___, перед тем, кто с Синая.
cases.explain: The preposition пред (before) in this archaic context governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В дни ___ сына Анафа, в дни Иаили пути опустели.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with temporal nouns takes the genitive plural form.

cases.sentence: И тогда Господень народ устремился к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case for indicating direction.

cases.sentence: Вы, кто ездит на белых ослицах, кто сидит на коврах, кто ходит по ___, пойте песнь.
cases.explain: The preposition по (by/along) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Поднимайся Варак, уводи своих рабов в ___.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion governs the accusative case.

reading.ru: Вожди повели Израиль, народ пошел добровольно, славьте Господа.
reading.question: How did the leaders and people respond in Israel?
options: The leaders led Israel and the people willingly offered themselves; bless Yahweh
The people refused to follow the leaders
reading.correct: The leaders led Israel and the people willingly offered themselves; bless Yahweh
reading.explain: The text states that the leaders led Israel and the people offered themselves willingly, and calls to bless Yahweh.

reading.ru: Когда вышел ты, Господи, из Сиира, когда выступил ты из земли Эдома, дрожала земля и с неба лило, облака изливали воду.
reading.question: What happened when Yahweh went out from Seir and the field of Edom?
options: The earth trembled, the heavens rained, and the clouds poured water
The sun stood still in the sky
reading.correct: The earth trembled, the heavens rained, and the clouds poured water
reading.explain: The text describes the physical manifestations: the earth trembled, sky dropped rain, and clouds poured water.

reading.ru: В дни Шамгара сына Анафа, в дни Иаили пути опустели, и ходившие прежде дорогой прямой, пускались в обход.
reading.question: What effect did the time of Shamgar and Jael have on travel in the land?
options: The highways were unoccupied and travelers took roundabout ways instead of the direct road
New roads were built for faster travel
All trade routes were moved to the coast
reading.correct: The highways were unoccupied and travelers took roundabout ways instead of the direct road
reading.explain: The text indicates the highways were desolate and travelers resorted to byways instead of the direct route.

reading.ru: Обезлюдили в Израиле села, обезлюдили, пока не явилась, не восстала я, Девора, мать в Израиле.
reading.question: What had happened to the villages of Israel before Deborah arose?
options: The villages had been emptied until Deborah arose as a mother in Israel
New cities were being built constantly
Villages were merging into one kingdom
reading.correct: The villages had been emptied until Deborah arose as a mother in Israel
reading.explain: The text states that the villages were unoccupied and deserted until Deborah arose as a mother figure in Israel.

reading.ru: Избрали новых богов, вот и война у ворот, и ни щита, ни копья не видно у сорока тысяч в Израиле.
reading.question: What was the consequence of Israel choosing new gods?
options: War came to the gates and no shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel
All the enemies fled without fighting
reading.correct: War came to the gates and no shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel
reading.explain: The text connects Israel's choice of new gods to the arrival of war and the people's lack of weapons and military preparation.

reading.ru: Но где склонился, там и упал мертвым.
reading.question: Where did Sisera fall after Jael struck him?
options: He fell dead at her feet where he bowed
He crawled away to another tent
He was carried to the river
reading.correct: He fell dead at her feet where he bowed
reading.explain: The text poetically emphasizes that Sisera fell and died at the very place where he bowed before Jael.
